interpretationUnits.title: Motion and environment-first configuration
interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: The solar anchor resolves to motion M1 and environment-first configuration ECR-H01; the upper trigram is used as environment priority and the lower trigram as embodied response position. The change pattern can be read through the relation between surrounding field and embodied response: Change proceeds by holding, receiving and carrying what must remain together. The environment-priority configuration emphasizes containment in the surrounding field while the embodied response position emphasizes containment. This is an ECR structural convention, not an I Ching fortune claim. If environment and response position are collapsed into one meaning, the environment-first distinction is lost.

interpretationUnits.title: Activation stage of the configuration
interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: Within configuration ECR-H01, the solar anchor occupies activation stage A1. interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: 十二种驱动始终存在。出生坐标基线按照 ECR 太阳锚点扇区距离规则，把 D9 排在首位；这不是对当前现实驱动优先级的判定。 首位基线驱动可以作为一种组织倾向阅读：释放已经无法继续承载运行的结构。 把基线亲和度当成实时优先级，会遮蔽当前约束、反馈和资源的影响。

interpretationUnits.title: 运动与环境优先配置
interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: 太阳锚点落入运动 M6 与环境优先配置 ECR-H44；上卦用于环境优先位，下卦用于载体回应位置。 变化方式可以从外部场域与载体回应之间的关系来阅读：变化通过停止、界定或稳定边界而展开。；环境优先配置以界定运动作为外部场域重点，同时以渗透运动作为载体回应位置。这是 ECR 的结构约定，不是易经吉凶判断。 如果把环境与回应位置压成同一个意义，环境优先这一关键区别就会消失。
